stalled_turn: {holder} has produced no output for a while and may be waiting for confirmation in the computer terminal or stalled; only local history can be synced
shared_socket_gone: app-server is running, but its shared control socket is gone (try running codex app-server daemon restart on the computer); only local history can be synced for now
shared_endpoint_invalid: app-server is running, but Persona could not validate its shared endpoint; only local history can be synced for now
shared_unreachable: app-server is running, but Persona could not connect to its shared endpoint; only local history can be synced for now
shared_home_mismatch: app-server is running, but its CODEX_HOME does not match this session; only local history can be synced for now
shared_not_loaded: app-server is running, but this session is not loaded on its shared endpoint yet; only local history can be synced for now
